items.excerpt: Pinless Debit Card-Present Traffic Being Routed Back on The Card Network Rails
items.note: Merchant-side fraud/payments leader reporting that large merchants saw card-present pinless debit pushed back to Visa/Mastercard rails. Comment thread (Frank T. Young) names STAR, Accel and NYCE as the affected processor-owned networks; post itself names no single network, so tagged group slug. Claim is sentiment, not verified fact. Month from LinkedIn activity id and '2y' age; archive lookup not run (budget).

items.excerpt: Regional debit networks have adopted a credit card processing model, making them a viable alternative to Visa and Mastercard and their processing fees.
items.note: Retail trade-body proxy for merchants. Article covers STAR, Accel, NYCE and Pulse as a group, so tagged group slug. Archive lookup not run (budget).

items.author_as_shown: Roger Applewhite, subject matter expert, Secure Remote Payment Council
items.excerpt: send debit transactions to the regional network of your choice instead of Visa and Mastercard
items.note: Quoted in NACS piece; SRPC is an industry council focused on PINless/remote debit. Excerpt is a contiguous fragment of a longer quote. Same source as previous item, so counts as one source for tiering.

items.author_as_shown: Maria Koops, Business Consultant Issuing, Financial Services, Worldline
items.excerpt: Worldline is committed to facilitating the transition to Debit Mastercard and Visa Debit by providing robust support for the issuance of these new brands.
items.note: European processor/acquirer on the Maestro retirement; about the European Maestro brand, not US PIN debit. Service-positioning rather than evaluation of Mastercard; no merchant-burden stance stated.

items.excerpt: Fifth Third Bank will no longer offer free ATM access to PSE Credit Union members
items.note: Issuer notice on the Jeanie ATM network sunset (effective 2025-08-01); redirects members to CULIANCE, Alliance One and shared branching. Records network exit, not a judgement of Jeanie or CULIANCE.

items.platform: Independent Community Bankers of Colorado (icbcolo.org) associate member page
items.excerpt: one of the last remaining member-owned and -controlled electronic funds transfer (EFT) networks and processors in the industry.
items.note: State community-bank association listing SHAZAM as associate member; descriptive, no explicit endorsement. Undated page; older flag unknown, set false.

items.author_as_shown: Steve Berman, attorney, Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro
items.excerpt: We are pleased and look forward to sending the money to the class and closing out this long-running case
items.note: Plaintiffs' counsel on the $197.5M settlement of the ATM access-fee antitrust litigation against Visa (Plus) and Mastercard (Cirrus). The underlying ATM-operator allegation is critical, but National ATM Council (Bruce Renard) did not comment; no verbatim operator voice found. Also concerns cirrus.

top_topics: other (network exits and brand retirement: Jeanie sunset, Maestro retirement)
notes: 30-call budget used (6 API calls, 10 WebSearch, 14 WebFetch). The prescribed 9-query set x 11 networks (99 queries) could not fit, so combined cross-network queries were used instead; per-network developer/API/sandbox/certification/onboarding/support queries were NOT run. Every network-audience cell is Absent (0-2 items); none reaches Thin. Reddit returned an HTML block page for both subreddits (0 results, not a real zero). Stack Overflow hits were all pre-2020 and off-topic. HN hits were general commenters, not partners, so none coded. G2/Capterra/TrustRadius not checked (budget), so no_listing is empty rather than confirmed. Wayback lookups not run (budget); archive_url null throughout. EXCLUDED as out of scope or not partner voices: network-owner executives (FIS CEO Stephanie Ferris praising NYCE, 2026-05-26; Fiserv CEO Frank Bisignano on STAR/Accel, 2023-05-26 and 2024-02-06); equity analysts (Baird, TD Cowen) on a possible STAR/Accel sale (Payments Dive 2026-07-08); Redbridge 2021 and Digital Transactions 2013 Interlink pieces (before window); a Doug Kantor (NACS/MPC) quote seen only in a search summary without a verifiable source URL; wein.plus Maestro merchant article (HTTP 401). Balance rule could not be met for any audience: merchant has only a critical item; institutional has favourable and neutral but no critical. Context found but not coded: Fiserv's reported 2025 rate increases (merchantcostconsulting.com, a cost-consulting vendor) and a bank-consortium exploring purchase of STAR/Accel. No public partner voice at all for AFFN, Accel alone, NYCE alone, Interlink, CULIANCE (beyond being named as a replacement network) or Cirrus alone.
